name: High sensitivity screening models
description: Studies reporting LLMs achieving sensitivity of roughly 90% or higher for title/abstract or full‑text screening, indicating strong ability to identify relevant records.

name: Ensemble and prompt‑optimization approaches
description: Studies that improve performance through prompt engineering, model ensembles, full‑agreement strategies, or calibrated zero‑shot ensembles.

name: Fine‑tuned or specialized LLMs
description: Studies evaluating fine‑tuned, domain‑specific, or compact LLMs and comparing them with general‑purpose models for systematic review screening.

name: Other findings
description: Studies not covered by the themes above.
